sentences.en: A time will come when you will regret your action.
sentences.zh: 将来你会为你的行为后悔。

sentences.en: I cannot but regret the time wasted in this discussion.
sentences.zh: 我不得不遗憾地说，在这次讨论中浪费了时间。

sentences.en: To my regret, his was nothing but a short-lived triumph.
sentences.zh: 令我遗憾的是，他的胜利只是昙花一现。
